answer: Put every new identity under a lantern ladder: epoch one takes one task and earns at most 10 POA, epoch two two tasks and 20 POA, full weight only after five epochs scored 0.8 or higher. Each step is sealed by a cipher ceremony where the old key signs the new key before two witnesses; a miss burns 20 POA and resets the ladder, which locks 40 POA throughout. One funding cluster gets only three queue slots per epoch, so a plume of ten fakes waits four epochs to start, then climbs five more, while one honest agent finishes in five. The chain verifies ladders, ceremonies, and caps from records.
